items.name: ISR & Targeting payloads contract, international customer
items.claim: Elbit Systems signed contracts with an international customer in an aggregate value of approximately $270 million, in the field of advanced ISR & Targeting payloads, to be performed over a period of up to six years, supplying systems from its SPECTRO family of multi-spectral electro-optic ISTAR solutions.
items.source_excerpt: Elbit Systems Signed Contracts with an International Customer Valued at Approximately $270 Million for Advanced ISR & Targeting Payloads Haifa, Israel, September 1, 2026 – Elbit Systems Ltd . (NASDAQ: ESLT) (TASE: ESLT) (“Elbit Systems” or the “Company”) announced today that it has signed contracts with an international customer, in an aggregate value of approximately $270 million, in the field of advanced ISR & Targeting payloads, to be performed over a period of up to six years.

items.name: Order backlog, as of June 30 2026
items.claim: Elbit Systems reported an order backlog of $32.0 billion as of June 30, 2026, alongside revenues of $2,287.1 million for the three months then ended.
items.source_excerpt: The Company reported $2,287.1 million in revenues for the three months ended June 30, 2026 and an order backlog of $32.0 billion as of such date.

notes: Both items sourced from the same stored 6-K exhibit (data/edgar/docs/ESLT.json): the CONTRACT item is the filing's substantive announcement, the BACKLOG item is the standard company-boilerplate paragraph appended to it.
